findings.claim: The MessagePackSecurity copy constructor no longer preserves HashCollisionResistant. Cloning MessagePackSecurity.UntrustedData therefore produces an instance with the default false value, silently disabling collision-resistant hashing and re-exposing deserialized untrusted maps to hash-collision denial-of-service attacks.

receipt_plan.detail: Create a derived MessagePackSecurity instance by copying MessagePackSecurity.UntrustedData (or clone it through WithMaximumObjectGraphDepth), then assert that the copy.HashCollisionResistant is true. Also deserialize a string-keyed map using the copied options under a deterministic collision scenario and verify that the collision-resistant comparer is still used.
